slide1.title: Book your class in seconds
slide1.body: A clear weekly schedule, one-tap booking and a waitlist when a class is full.

slide2.title: Log every exercise, every set
slide2.body: Start a session, log weights and reps, and let the rest timer do the counting.

slide3.title: Watch your progress climb
slide3.body: Personal records, charts for your weight and measurements, and a streak that keeps you going.
